_comment: Live addons used to playtest StreamioLink. Movie/series config: catalogs + sources. The musicRadio section lists music/radio addons used as both catalog and source. The plugin accepts either the base URL or the manifest.json URL. Movie test: tt0111161 (The Shawshank Redemption).

sources.name: hdhub
sources.notes: Direct signed CDN links (R2 + pixeldrain). Fast and reliable.

sources.name: pengu
sources.notes: Aggregator; links are pengu.uk/direct/... 307 redirects to the same CDN objects hdhub returns (~8s redirect).

sources.name: cnc
sources.notes: CNCVerse Bridge. 18 other (VOD) + 12 tv catalogs; other and tv both participate in home/search. Many links; ~1/3 dead (404 / connection refused / HTML); 9/18 sampled VOD catalogs were streamless; skip is ignored.

sources.name: playvio
sources.notes: http sources addon with livetv catalog

sources.name: yuki
sources.notes: http addon with both catalog and sources

musicRadio._comment: Music/radio addons used for playtesting. Both declare catalog, meta and stream; configure them as catalog addons with 'use as source' enabled.

catalogs.name: Radios
catalogs.notes: 93k SHOUTcast stations. Music catalog with search/skip/genre; items are type movie with radios: ids; streams are direct audio URLs (extension-less Shoutcast/Icecast).

catalogs.name: Flix-Music
catalogs.notes: Last.fm discovery with three movie-type catalogs (Music - Top/Trending/Search) and lfm: ids. Sampled stream responses were empty (addon-side), so playback is unverified.

sources.name: Radios
sources.notes: Same addon as the catalog: use it as a source to play station ids from its catalog.

sources.name: Flix-Music
sources.notes: Same addon as the catalog: streams are looked up by lfm: id; sampled responses were empty.

youtube._comment: Reddate YT: movie catalogs (Trending/Music/Gaming/News/Sports/Science) plus a search-only channel catalog. Streams carry ytId; the externalUrl duplicate is skipped.

catalogs.name: Reddate YT
catalogs.notes: YouTube catalogs. Movie rows load on home; 'YouTube channels' has required search, so it is search-only. Channel metas expose uploads as numbered videos and load as a series.

sources.name: Reddate YT
sources.notes: Same addon as the catalog: video and channel-upload ids stream via ytId through CloudStream's YouTube extractor.
